title: Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: BEDMINSTER, N.J., July 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation (NASDAQ Global Select Market: PGC) announced on July 30, 2026 that its Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.05 per share on its common stock. The dividend will be paid on August 27, 2026 to shareholders of record as of August 13, 2026. Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation is a New Jersey bank holding company with total assets of $8.0 billion and assets under management and/or administration of $13.9 billion as of June 30, 2026. Founded in 1921, Peapack Private Bank Trust is a boutique private bank serving successful individuals, families, business owners, family offices, and their trusted advisors through personalized relationships and bespoke banking, lending, wealth management, investment banking and trust solutions.
